items.name: Lightning Spell
items.info: Electrocute your enemies with a bolt of lightning!\n\nCast this spell at the enemy village to damage and stun buildings and units inside a small area.

items.name: Healing Spell
items.info: Heal your troops to keep them in the fight!\n\nCast this spell to create a Ring of Healing. Your units will be healed while they are inside this ring.

items.name: Rage Spell
items.info: Enrage your units to make them bigger, faster and stronger!\n\nCast this to create a Ring of Rage! Your units will gain speed and attack power while they are inside this ring.

items.name: Jump Spell
items.info: Walls slowing you down? Try making a shortcut!\n\nCast this spell near enemy walls to create a route straight over them. Your troops will jump over affected wall pieces as if they weren't even there!

items.name: Freeze Spell
items.info: When the going gets hot, stay frosty!\n\nThe Freeze Spell sends out a cryogenic blast that temporarily immobilizes enemy troops and disables defensive buildings within its radius.

items.name: Santa's Surprise
items.info: Ask Santa for the best present there is: a hail of destruction raining down on your enemies!

items.name: Poison Spell
items.info: Give your army the upper hand against enemy troops with this deadly poison!\n\nDefending units that linger in a Poison Spell's toxic cloud will move slower, attack slower and take damage with increasing severity over time. Poison Spells do not affect structures.

items.name: Earthquake Spell
items.info: Weaken ground targets with crippling earthquakes!\n\nEarthquake Spells damage targets based on their maximum hitpoints. Repeated earthquakes deal decreasing damage to the same targets, but no wall can withstand the might of four Earthquake Spells!

items.name: Haste Spell
items.info: Put some hustle in even your heaviest units!\n\nHaste Spells lack the damage boost of Rage Spells, but provide an even better boost to movement speed. A lower storage space also allows you to take more of them into battle!

items.name: Clone Spell
items.info: Turn this spell into a pop-up army!\n\nClone Spells create a circle of spawning that creates limited-lifetime copies of troops that enter it. It will only spawn up to a maximum housing space of troops.

items.name: Skeleton Spell
items.info: Summon an army of Skeletons anywhere on the battlefield!\n\nPut a few extra swords when and where you need them most. Skeletons do not trigger traps.

items.name: Bat Spell
items.info: Summon an army of Bats anywhere on the battlefield!\n\nDeploy aerial reinforcements wherever you need them the most. Bats do not trigger traps.

items.name: Invisibility Spell
items.info: Invisibility Spell makes EVERYTHING, except for walls and Siege Machines, invisible and untargetable within its radius.

items.name: Recall Spell
items.info: Attack going badly? Need to come in from another direction? The Recall Spell summons back troops, Heroes and Pets to the deployment bar. You can then send the recalled units back out for a second strike.

items.name: Overgrowth Spell
items.info: Ever wish you could ignore a whole chunk of the enemy’s base? The Overgrowth Spell traps nearby buildings in tough roots, preventing defenses from attacking. Troops ignore trapped buildings.

items.name: Bag of Frostmites
items.info: Briefly freezes the target area and slowly summons bouncing Frostmites which slow down and distract the nearby defenses.

items.name: Revive Spell
items.info: The Healer's own special recipe! The Revive Spell brings a defeated Hero in its range back into the fight with some health. Bring this spell into battle, and a floating golden heart will appear above any defeated Hero that can be revived. Upgrade the Revive Spell to increase the amount of health Heroes regain.

items.name: Ice Block Spell
items.info: A brrr-illiant defensive strategy!\n\nCast this cool concoction to encase your ground and air troops in ice that blocks almost all damage but freezes their movement and attack!

items.name: Totem Spell
items.info: Incoming! Ground and air defenses in a Totem’s landing zone are damaged and stunned. Stunned defenses will redirect their focus to the closest available unit. Forged from dense cosmic rock, Totems can soak up a lot of damage.

items.name: Angry Spell
items.info: Why I oughta!\n\n Distilled from the jelly of the Pet House’s grumpiest resident, the Angry Spell infuriates troops within its ironically sweet-smelling radius, making them target defenses temporarily.
